label: Full-history retrospective · provisional ranking
coverage: 764 eligible matches · 182,713 delivery events · run value per 100 weighted legal balls
notes:
Five held-out groups keep each evaluated match out of its own model fit. Later matches may help assess earlier matches.
A strict historical replay cannot estimate the first match from this pack alone.
Chase model: runs needed, legal balls and wickets left. Setting model: estimated remaining runs plus current score, then historical defence probability.
T20 resource projection uses balls and wickets together, based on observed finishes. It does not calculate an official DLS target.
Outcome probabilities borrow strength from nearby states and broader phase history when exact states are sparse.
Pressure multiplier: (1 + delivery pressure / mean pressure for the innings) / 2.
Overall form uses stage weights. Pressure form uses stage weights times the pressure multiplier.
Both scores divide the weighted run value by weighted legal-ball exposure plus 50, then multiply by 100.
Eligibility: at least 100 legal balls across at least five matches. The 80th percentile is a display count only.
Regulation sample excludes unresolved or revised games and super overs. Two emerging-team competitions are outside the IPL/T20I scope.

Stage totals: {'regular': 740, 'knockout': 15, 'final': 9}.

rules.bowler_runs: bat runs plus extras1_runs except byes, leg-byes and penalties. Secondary extras on no-ball-like deliveries remain team runs.
rules.regulation_winner: batting-side win credit, 0.5 for documented regulation tie
rules.scope: Revised games and super-over matches excluded entirely. Delivery outcomes and win credit are labels, not pressure predictors.
rules.over_validation: Full nonterminal overs must contain six inferred legal deliveries.
